Revision toolkit: everything the reviewers will ask for, measurable on demand.

- Stratified pair serving (family x region x similarity balance) for the growing
  annotation campaign.
- Dawid-Skene log-odds consensus: adversarial votes now count against themselves;
  validated on synthetic adversaries (+0.18 accuracy with an inverter present).
- One-command reports: inter-annotator agreement (alpha, weighted kappa, disagreement
  taxonomy), multilingual-embedding baselines, canonicalisation & cluster audits.
